title: Software Tester
description:
We're a small US software company. We build fast with AI\-assisted development, and we need one exceptional manual tester who finds what the automated tests miss. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role. You will be the first dedicated tester on the team, reporting to the founder.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Test new features and fixes before they reach customers: end\-to\-end workflows, edge cases, data imports, payments, permissions, and multi\-tenant isolation.
* Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in one read — steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots or video, severity, and what you think the cause is.
* Build and maintain the test checklist for each product area; keep a regression pass that runs before every release.
* Verify data migrations: source records vs. what the system shows, count by count, field by field.
* Communicate proactively. You'll tell the team what you're testing, what you found, and when you'll be online — before anyone asks.
* Push back. If something ships that you flagged, we want to hear about it.



  





**Must Have** 



* 3\+ years of manual / exploratory testing on a production web application, with references who can describe your work.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to engineers and occasionally read customer\-reported issues. This is assessed on the call and in your writing sample — please apply only if you're genuinely fluent.
* Experience testing financial software — payments, banking, lending, collections, or billing — where correctness is mandatory.
* Meticulous documentation habits. Show us a bug report you're proud of.
* **Flexibility. There is no set schedule. You'll work around the team's time tables — the founder, the implementation manager, and the engineer are in US time zones — and part of the job is live: reproducing a bug on a call, walking an engineer through what you found, joining a release check before it goes out. Some weeks that means early mornings IST, some weeks late nights. If you need a fixed shift, this isn't the role. What we ask in return is that you communicate — when you're available, when you're not, and what you found — clearly and without being chased.**



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Time spent in a US debt\-collections or receivables BPO — as an agent, QA, or trainer. You'll understand the users on day one.
* Experience with SFTP file imports, CSV data mapping, or CRM systems.
* Basic SQL to check what's actually in a table.



  





**Compensation:** 
 monthly contractor rate, paid via a global payroll platform, negotiated on experience. A paid one\-week work trial on real test cases precedes any offer.

description:
The Opportunity

 As an AU Controls Testing \- Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions to help organizations navigate complex regulatory landscapes and enhance their internal controls. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will be part of a team that focuses on governance, risk, controls, and compliance, confirming regulatory compliance and managing risks effectively.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work even when the path forward is unclear. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, while upholding professional and technical standards. This opportunity allows you to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using reflection to enhance your strengths and address development areas.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Conducting controls testing to assess the effectiveness of internal controls and compliance frameworks
* Experience in controls testing, internal audit, IT audit or risk assurance, with a sound technical foundation in control design and operating effectiveness testing.
* Demonstrated ability to perform and document control testing independently of control ownership, to a consistent quality standard.
* Sound understanding of risk and control frameworks and how controls mitigate operational, financial and compliance risks.
* Experience developing and executing control test plans, and reporting on control effectiveness and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to work through complex processes and regulatory obligations to map obligations to risks and controls, and to assess how effectively risks are mitigated.
* Ability to gather and evaluate evidence and reach supportable, evidence\-based observations on control effectiveness and residual risk.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the identification of control weaknesses and root causes.
* Accuracy and attention to detail in preparing clear, complete and reviewable working papers.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including conveying technical testing findings clearly to reviewers and stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote or offshore delivery model, coordinating across time zones and managing competing deadlines.


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Full time graduation or the equivalent degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Demonstrating proficiency in Controls Testing and Corporate Governance
* Utilizing creativity to solve complex problems and generate new ideas
* Navigating ambiguity while maintaining professional and technical standards
* Experience in professional services, partnership structures or similarly complex governance environments.
* Practical experience using GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Familiarity with data analytics or automation applied to control testing.
* Experience testing IT\-dependent and automated controls, with awareness of information security and IT general controls.
* Strong report\-writing capability, including preparing clear testing observations and issue documentation.
* Progress towards a relevant tertiary qualification or certification (e.g. CA, CPA, CIA, CISA, IIA).
* Knowledge of relevant frameworks and standards (e.g. COSO, ISO 31000, NIST CSF)
* Shift time \- 7am to 3pm IST

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
